robotPageSubtitle: RAL proudly showcases a cutting-edge collection of recently acquired robots, including the AgileX Scout Mini mobile robot, Go2/Go2W, Hexapod, Universal Robots UR5e, and DJI Matrice 350 RTK. Stay tuned for more exciting additions!

robots.robotsData: The AgileX Scout Mini is a wheeled mobile robot powered by an NVIDIA Jetson Orin and outfitted with a cutting-edge sensor suite: a 32-beam RS-Helios LiDAR for 360° depth perception, a ZED2i stereo camera for RGB-D imaging, and a Fixposition Vision-RTK2 module for centimeter-level GNSS-RTK localization.

The Unitree Go2-W is a wheeled–legged quadruped robot used as a versatile platform for locomotion and navigation research. It is equipped with a Livox Mid-360 LiDAR and an onboard NVIDIA Jetson computer, enabling real-time perception, SLAM, and control within a ROS 2 framework. Its hybrid mobility design supports both efficient traversal on flat terrain and robust operation in complex environments.

The DOBOT Hexplorer is a six-legged robotic platform designed for stable locomotion and multi-terrain operation. It is equipped with a Livox Mid-360 LiDAR and an onboard computing system, enabling real-time perception, SLAM, and control within a ROS 2 framework. Its bio-inspired hexapod design provides high stability and load-carrying capability, making it suitable for operation in complex and unstructured environments.

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK, our lab’s heavy-lift multirotor, is a weather-sealed, RTK-enabled platform for centimeter-accurate aerial data and autonomous missions. With dual batteries, O3 Enterprise video, and a flexible gimbal for LiDAR or ROS 2 sensors, it excels in mapping, inspection, photogrammetry, SLAM, and search-and-rescue drills.

The Unitree A2-W Pro is an industrial wheeled-legged quadruped robot designed for high-mobility operation in complex environments. It combines efficient wheeled locomotion with the terrain adaptability of legged robots and is equipped with dual LiDAR sensors, an HD camera, and two high-performance computing platforms for perception and autonomous development.
